Title: Vinod's Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 61 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Hema - 31 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Nitin - 37 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The ghat - Day

[Vinod stands on the ghat. Sonali and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod drowns in the river.]

Sonali: "Rest in peace."
